title: Travel agent software: a 2-minute BEEASY PLUS tour
description:
What is BEEASY PLUS and how does it help a travel agency? A two-minute tour of search, client proposals, CRM and the agent website.

A quick welcome tour of BEEASY PLUS, the platform for travel agents: what to do first, where every tool lives, and how to start working: settings and branding, search, client proposals, bookings, and plans.

Recorded on a fictional demo agency. All names and data are examples only.

Join BEEASY PLUS: https://plus.beeasy.pro/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=beeasy-plus-onboarding-en
